filtersInspected.behavior: Correctly filters the live board to active in-play fixtures.
filtersInspected.flaw: Previously, when a user clicked a placed bet on a finished match, the frontend only looked in this live array and failed to fetch the persistent match record.

filtersInspected.behavior: Supported query filters by sport and status.

resolution: Frontend Sports.jsx now uses an asynchronous fallback to /api/v1/matches/:id when a selected match is no longer on the live board, displaying the complete historical match card and status.
